legal.deliverable: dated table of US federal rule effective dates, comment windows, filing deadlines, and the one action each date triggers
legal.ai_scope: extract US federal dates and entities from primary notices; draft one-line plain-language rows; never interpret whether a rule applies

financial.deliverable: dated table of US proposed and final rules, compliance dates, and the operational change each one forces
financial.ai_scope: extract US rule status, dates, and affected entities; summarize the operational change; never rate an investment or predict markets

behavioral-health.deliverable: five-item weekly brief on payer policy, telehealth rules, and safety alerts that change practice operations
behavioral-health.ai_scope: summarize regulator and payer notices; label operational impact; never give clinical guidance or triage

education.deliverable: five-item brief on enrollment dates, accreditation actions, and aid deadlines with a dated action list
education.ai_scope: extract dates and institution names; summarize the decision the date forces; never guarantee admission, aid, or outcomes

logistics.deliverable: dated table of US port disruptions, customs notices, and border changes with the lane each one touches
logistics.ai_scope: extract US notice dates, ports, and effective windows; summarize the operational change; never quote a rate or transit-time guarantee
logistics.reviewer: customs or freight operations reviewer required

cybersecurity.deliverable: 5-12 new known-exploited vulnerabilities, filtered to the reader's vendor stack, one action per row
cybersecurity.ai_scope: filter, dedupe, and paraphrase the required action; never claim a system is safe or a patch is sufficient

stem-cell.deliverable: dated table of US trial status changes, FDA notices, and manufacturing updates with a plain-language change line
stem-cell.ai_scope: extract US registry status, phase, sponsor, and dates; summarize what changed; never call a therapy safe, effective, or approved

manufacturing.deliverable: dated table of US recalls, safety notices, and regulator actions with product, hazard, and action
manufacturing.ai_scope: extract US product, hazard, and remedy; link the notice; never certify compliance or reinterpret a standard

energy.deliverable: dated table of US interconnection queue changes, docket milestones, and rate-case dates with the project each one touches
energy.ai_scope: extract US queue status, dates, and jurisdictions; summarize the milestone; never forecast prices or interconnection outcomes

retail.deliverable: dated table of US consumer-protection effective dates, recalls, and comment windows with the commercial action
retail.ai_scope: extract US dates, products, and obligations; summarize the commercial change; never forecast demand or promise sales lift

digital-technology.deliverable: five-item weekly brief on model releases, platform policy changes, chip export rules, and datacenter constraints
digital-technology.ai_scope: summarize official releases and policy text; link the primary source; never benchmark a model or predict procurement outcomes
